anomalies.observed: Both VCAP pins of the STM32H753 (pins 48 and 73, power_out) are each tied to a signal pin of the UART3_FCC2 connector (pin 3 on NET0071, pin 4 on NET0124). The VCAP pins have no decoupling capacitor and no other connection.
anomalies.expected: VCAP is an internal regulator output that should connect only to its own decoupling capacitors (2.2 uF each) and must not be routed to an external connector. The UART3 lines should go to the USART pins (e.g. PD8/PD9, which are left unconnected in this netlist).
anomalies.impact: The internal core regulator output is loaded and shorted to a connector pin with no capacitor, which can destabilise the core supply. UART3 would not be functional on the intended MCU pins.

anomalies.observed: The two VSS pins of the navigation MCU (pins 18 and 63) form an isolated, auto-named net that does not include GND. The VDD and VSSA pins of NAVC2 are also not on any supply or ground net.
anomalies.expected: All VSS pins of the STM32F405 should be on the GND net, as the FCC2 VSS pins are.
anomalies.impact: The navigation MCU's ground pins are not connected to the board ground, so the MCU cannot run correctly or reference its I/O levels.

anomalies.observed: The PCA9685PW address pin A0 (pin 1) is tied to +3.3V while A1 to A5 are tied to GND, which gives I2C address 0x41, not the default 0x40 stated in the spec.
anomalies.expected: Spec lists the PCA9685 at I2C address 0x40, which requires A0 to be tied to GND. However, the INA219 is also at 0x40 on the same bus, so the design may have set A0 high on purpose to avoid a conflict.

evidence.quote: PWM/servo driver | FCCPeripherals | NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40

anomalies.impact: Firmware addressing the PCA9685 at 0x40 would fail to reach the driver. The conflict with the INA219 may make the spec's address ambiguous.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows no clearly injected discrete-component error, and the passive values match the SPICE deck. The most concrete deviations are the FCC VCAP pins wired to UART3 connector pins and the NAVC VSS pins not on GND, but the many unwired MCU power and pin connections make these findings uncertain.
